1.web: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, neither shall you raise up an engraved image or a pillar, neither shall you place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am Yahweh your God.
1.asv: Ye shall make you no idols, neither shall ye rear you up a graven image, or a pillar, neither shall ye place any figured stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am Jehovah your God.

2.web: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.
2.asv: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Jehovah.

3.web: “‘If you walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
3.asv: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

4.web: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
4.asv: then I will give your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

5.web: Your threshing shall reach to the vintage, and the vintage shall reach to the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
5.asv: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time; and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

6.web: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
6.asv: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

7.web: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
7.asv: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

8.web: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
8.asv: And five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

9.web: “‘I will have respect for you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.
9.asv: And I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

10.web: You shall eat old store long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.
10.asv: And ye shall eat old store long kept, and ye shall bring forth the old because of the new.

11.web: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.
11.asv: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

12.web: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.
12.asv: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

13.web: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you go upright.
13.asv: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you go upright.

14.web: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments;
14.asv: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

15.web: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant;
15.asv: and if ye shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhor mine ordinances, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant;

16.web: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.
16.asv: I also will do this unto you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away; and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

17.web: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.
17.asv: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be smitten before your enemies: they that hate you shall rule over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

18.web: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
18.asv: And if ye will not yet for these things hearken unto me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

19.web: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like brass.
19.asv: And I will break the pride of your power: and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass;

20.web: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.
20.asv: and your strength shall be spent in vain; for your land shall not yield its increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruit.

21.web: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.
21.asv: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me, I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

22.web: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.
22.asv: And I will send the beast of the field among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your ways shall become desolate.

23.web: “‘If by these things you won’t be reformed to me, but will walk contrary to me;
23.asv: And if by these things ye will not be reformed unto me, but will walk contrary unto me;

24.web: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.
24.asv: then will I also walk contrary unto you; and I will smite you, even I, seven times for your sins.

25.web: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
25.asv: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall execute the vengeance of the covenant; and ye shall be gathered together within your cities: and I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

26.web: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.
26.asv: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

27.web: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me;
27.asv: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

28.web: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.
28.asv: then I will walk contrary unto you in wrath; and I also will chastise you seven times for your sins.

29.web: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.
29.asv: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

30.web: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.
30.asv: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your sun-images, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul shall abhor you.

31.web: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.
31.asv: And I will make your cities a waste, and will bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savor of your sweet odors.

32.web: I will bring the land into desolation; and your enemies that dwell therein will be astonished at it.
32.asv: And I will bring the land into desolation; and your enemies that dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

33.web: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
33.asv: And you will I scatter among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you: and your land shall be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

34.web: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
34.asv: Then shall the land enjoy its sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye are in your enemies’ land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy its sabbaths.

35.web: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths, when you lived on it.
35.asv: As long as it lieth desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it had not in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

36.web: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.
36.asv: And as for them that are left of you, I will send a faintness into their heart in the lands of their enemies: and the sound of a driven leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as one fleeth from the sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

37.web: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.
37.asv: And they shall stumble one upon another, as it were before the sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

38.web: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.
38.asv: And ye shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

39.web: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.
39.asv: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

40.web: “‘If they confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me, and also that, because they walked contrary to me,
40.asv: And they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me, and also that, because they walked contrary unto me,

41.web: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity;
41.asv: I also walked contrary unto them, and brought them into the land of their enemies: if then their uncircumcised heart be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity;

42.web: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob; and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.
42.asv: then will I remember my covenant with Jacob; and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

43.web: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them: and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity; because, even because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.
43.asv: The land also shall be left by them, and shall enjoy its sabbaths, while it lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity; because, even because they rejected mine ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

44.web: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God;
44.asv: And yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them; for I am Jehovah their God;

45.web: but I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am Yahweh.’”
45.asv: but I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God: I am Jehovah.

46.web: These are the statutes, ordinances and laws, which Yahweh made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.
46.asv: These are the statutes and ordinances and laws, which Jehovah made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by Moses.
